constraint: Perform an honest visual-preservation ImageGen edit of rejected attempt-003; whole-canvas resampling or redrawing is allowed and no pixels are claimed immutable. Preserve exactly three complete people, one calm pack mule with soft cloth cargo, exactly three upright foreground bark staffs, the road, valley, treeless slopes, crop, palette, lighting and Wands rendering. Change only the distant viewer-right walker’s outer viewer-right forearm and hand plus the immediately adjacent ochre garment edge, road stones and hillside. Erase the existing short diagonal mark only along its current narrow footprint from the outer wrist to its free endpoint, then reconstruct matching road-stone and hillside texture within that narrow strip. Repaint the empty hand held close beside the hip with the forearm angled slightly inward. Keep one visibly background-colored separation immediately outside the repaired hand and hip. No continuous elongated mark may touch or emerge from the hand, wrist, forearm, hip or garment silhouette; ordinary short disconnected rock texture and the natural limb outline are allowed. The hand must be anatomically five-digit and proportional to the other distant hands; fingers may overlap naturally and need not be individually readable. Do not move, enlarge, merge or rescale either walker, the mule or the three foreground staffs. Preserve the mule-side hand as empty and separated from tack. Garment straps remain only inside the torso and end at the waist. Add no fourth person, second animal, cart, wheel, rigid cargo frame, harness shaft, tree, branch, fence, post, mast, pole, rod, tool handle, fourth staff, text or other elongated object beyond the three foreground staffs. At full size require both distant walker hands empty and no outgoing mark from the outer silhouette. At 140×196 require only 3 people, 1 mule, 3 foreground staff identities and no fourth rod-like line; do not enlarge the hands merely for mobile detail.
reason: Attempt-003 removed the mule-side connection and most of the outer-hand line while preserving the Three of Wands scene, but one independent reviewer still found a short dark diagonal stroke with a free endpoint leaving the viewer-right wrist toward the lower-right road. Attempt-004 uses that exact rejected output as its sole source, permits honest resampling and repaints only the outer forearm, empty hand and immediately adjacent background to create an unambiguous clear corridor while preserving all passing counts, meaning, anatomy and style.
reviewer: Planck, Harvey and Halley (independent Three of Wands outer-hand corridor, bounded-edit, supersession provenance and full/mobile review)
